indicators.label: Apprenticeship starts (Northern Ireland)
indicators.subtitle: Apprenticeship programme starts by people aged 16 or above, per 100,000 people
indicators.longDescription: This indicator shows apprenticeships started by adults aged 16+ based on home address, rate per 100,000 population, in Northern Ireland, for full academic years 2019/20 to 2023/24
indicators.caveats: •	Starts refer to the number of participants who are in the first year of an apprenticeship programme. •	Data relate to participants who have been on their course 28 days or more. •	Geography is based upon the home postcode of the learner. •	ApprenticeshipsNI includes levels 2 and 3. •	Higher Level Apprenticeships (HLA) at further education (FE) colleges in Northern Ireland and the College of Agriculture, Food and Rural Enterprise (CAFRE) includes levels 4, 5 and 6. •	HLA at Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) in Northern Ireland includes levels 6 and 7. •	[2024 mid-year population estimates for Northern Ireland](https://www.nisra.gov.uk/publications/2024-mid-year-population-estimates-northern-ireland-and-estimates-population-aged-85) have been used to create a rate per 100,000 population. •	Figures produced by each UK nation may differ due to differing sources, time periods, age analysed or differences in methodologies so they are not directly comparable.
